verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing docs confirm a drag-and-drop email editor and basic email templates, which covers the visual-editor and template parts of the story. Personalization is described only in general marketing terms, with no documentation of merge or personalization tokens, brand controls, or how emails render across clients. missing for 10: documented personalization tokens/merge tags, on-brand styling or brand kit controls, reusable saved templates beyond 'basic', cross-client rendering/preview testing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
